item.title: Damage to wooden bollard caused by HGVs on Birdbrook Road, 13th September
item.description:
A wooden bollard on Birdbrook Road near the bridge has been completely knocked out of the pavement, leaving exposed rubble and creating a trip hazard (see attached photo). This damage was caused by heavy lorries and buses attempting to drive under the bridge, getting stuck due to the width restrictions, and striking the post while trying to reverse back out. This frequent reversing down the street is extremely unsafe for pedestrians and local traffic.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Birdbrook Road, Kidbrooke
